verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a GPU cloud console, but the evidence shows none inside Vast.ai. The `vastai` agent skill lets external AI coding assistants drive the platform. That is an integration for third-party agents, not an assistant built into the product, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
